newsitem.title: UK: Caradon to return 174 mln stg to shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Caradon to return 174 mln stg to shareholders.

text.p: Caradon Plc, the UK building materials group, said on Wednesday it planned to return capital worth 10 percent of its market value to shareholders -- a sum worth 174 million pounds

The return to shareholders will be made in May after being approved by shareholders. The news came as Caradon announced year profits of 178.2 million pounds, up 18 percent before exceptional items. It also announced an unchanged dividend at 9.5 pence per share.
Caradon CRN.l plans return of 174 million stg =2

On the return of capital, the group chief excecutive Peter Jansen said full details would be sent to shareholders and that even with the payback plans "The group will remain in a strong financial position and be well placed to continue the development of the core business."
The results showed better than expected cost cuts of 66 million pounds ($106.7 million) in 1996 and a net cash inflow of 65 million. European non-core disposal proceeds totalled 220 million pounds.

"Caradon made good progress in 1996," said Jansen, "We increased profitability, generated cash, took a significant step in focusing the group and we have strengthened the board with the promotion of two new executive directors," he said.
Caradon said 1997 had started slowly with trading in early months below expectaitons.
"Nevertheless we anticipate that the recovery in our UK markets, which was seen in the last quarter of 1996, will restart in the second quarter based on an upturn in new housing."
But, he said, other European markets remained difficult although North America was seen as positive. ($ = 0.618 British Pounds)
